name: Physics debris & breakables
oneLiner: Breakable props, either the game's own art (painted or pixel) or built-in crates, barrels, pots, statues and crystals, that crack when hit and shatter into pieces cut from their own drawing; each piece is a rigid body (position, velocity, angle, spin) that tumbles, bounces off walls and floors, slides, settles flat on a low edge, rests and fades. Every move is swept along its path, so pieces never pass through walls. Loose pieces of a material (rock, wood, clay, crystal, leaf, bark, bone, shell, iron, spirit) for creatures that break apart, dust puffs, a screen-shake offset, and a wall bump for knocked-back foes: dust and chips at the contact point, a reflected velocity and a visual bounce. Side view (gravity) and top-down (fake height with shadows). Pooled, deterministic from a seed, never changes game state.
notFor: turn-based menus with no world view (no place for props to fall)
games whose props must block movement or hold loot rules: add that in the game; the module only draws and reports breaks
physics puzzles that need stacking or exact rigid-body contact (pieces are cosmetic; no stacking)

needs: a fixed update step that calls update(dt) once per step after movement (also run by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1), update(0) while paused or behind a window
the game's wall test in world px (solid(x, y)), and its tile size when walls are tiles
the impact frame of each attack (a point or the hit box, the direction)
knock-back: the step a knocked-back body moves (touch) and the frame a wall stops it (contact point, wall normal, speed)
where foes are defeated (optional: shatter them into a material)
the draw pass: props with the sprites (y-sorted in top-down), pieces after the sprites, before the HUD, with the camera offset; clear() on new game and level change
provides: breakable props (crate, barrel, pot, statue, crystal) with hp, crack marks, hit flash and wobble; onBreak(info)
rigid-body pieces cut from the prop's art, swept against walls, resting and fading; loose material shards; dust puffs
wallHit(): dust and chips at a wall bump, a reflected velocity and a visual bounce offset(key) for the body's sprite
screen-shake offset shake() and onShake / onHitstop / onSound hooks
stats(), audit(), list(), hash() for tests and judges

params.label: Speed that breaks props on touch (px/s)

assets: module/physics-debris.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_Debris): prop art drawn in code (crate, barrel, pot, statue, crystal) cached at device resolution, fracture patterns computed from each silhouette (game art props: hull + material grids), piece sprites cut from the art with fresh-break rims, material shard sprites, pooled rigid bodies with swept tile or sampled wall tests, side and top-down physics, dust, wall bumps, shake
no image, font or audio files
